datapoints.label: Reporting undertaking
datapoints.requirement: Identify the reporting undertaking.

datapoints.label: Reporting period
datapoints.requirement: State the reporting period for the climate disclosures.

datapoints.label: Transition plan
datapoints.requirement: Describe the transition plan for climate-change mitigation.

datapoints.label: Climate targets
datapoints.requirement: Disclose climate-change mitigation and adaptation targets.

datapoints.label: Gross Scope 1 emissions
datapoints.requirement: Disclose gross Scope 1 GHG emissions.

datapoints.label: Gross Scope 2 emissions — location based
datapoints.requirement: Disclose gross location-based Scope 2 GHG emissions.

datapoints.label: Gross Scope 2 emissions — market based
datapoints.requirement: Disclose gross market-based Scope 2 GHG emissions.

datapoints.label: Gross Scope 3 emissions
datapoints.requirement: Disclose gross Scope 3 GHG emissions.

datapoints.label: Total GHG emissions — location based
datapoints.requirement: Disclose total GHG emissions using location-based Scope 2.

datapoints.label: GHG emissions intensity
datapoints.requirement: Disclose GHG intensity using an explicit denominator and methodology.

sec-climate.name: SEC climate disclosure — 2024 final-rule structured draft

datapoints.label: Registrant name
datapoints.requirement: Identify the registrant.

datapoints.label: Reporting period
datapoints.requirement: State the reporting period.

datapoints.label: Board oversight
datapoints.requirement: Describe board oversight of climate-related risks when applicable.

datapoints.label: Management role
datapoints.requirement: Describe management's role in assessing and managing material climate-related risks.

datapoints.label: Material climate risks
datapoints.requirement: Describe material climate-related risks and their actual or likely material impacts.

datapoints.label: Risk-management process
datapoints.requirement: Describe processes used to identify, assess, and manage material climate-related risks.

datapoints.label: Climate targets and goals
datapoints.requirement: Disclose material climate-related targets or goals and progress when applicable.

datapoints.label: Scope 1 emissions input
datapoints.requirement: Structured Scope 1 emissions input for professional applicability review.

datapoints.label: Scope 2 emissions input
datapoints.requirement: Structured location-based Scope 2 emissions input for professional applicability review.

datapoints.label: Reporting entity
datapoints.requirement: Identify the reporting entity.

datapoints.label: Reporting period
datapoints.requirement: State the reporting period.

datapoints.label: Governance
datapoints.requirement: Describe governance processes, controls, and procedures for climate-related risks and opportunities.

datapoints.label: Climate strategy
datapoints.requirement: Describe climate-related risks and opportunities and their effects on strategy and decision-making.

datapoints.label: Climate resilience
datapoints.requirement: Describe resilience of strategy and business model, informed by scenario analysis.

datapoints.label: Risk management
datapoints.requirement: Describe processes to identify, assess, prioritise, and monitor climate-related risks and opportunities.

datapoints.label: Gross Scope 1 emissions
datapoints.requirement: Disclose gross Scope 1 GHG emissions.

datapoints.label: Gross Scope 2 emissions
datapoints.requirement: Disclose gross Scope 2 GHG emissions using the selected method and methodology disclosures.

datapoints.label: Gross Scope 3 emissions
datapoints.requirement: Disclose gross Scope 3 GHG emissions under the applicable edition and reliefs.

datapoints.label: Climate targets
datapoints.requirement: Disclose climate-related targets and performance against them.

datapoints.label: Reporting organisation
datapoints.requirement: Identify the reporting organisation.

datapoints.label: Reporting period
datapoints.requirement: State the reporting period.

datapoints.label: Nature governance
datapoints.requirement: Describe governance of nature-related dependencies, impacts, risks, and opportunities.

datapoints.label: Nature dependencies and impacts
datapoints.requirement: Describe material nature-related dependencies and impacts.

datapoints.label: Nature risks and opportunities
datapoints.requirement: Describe nature-related risks and opportunities and their effects.

datapoints.label: Priority locations
datapoints.requirement: Identify priority locations, including sensitive locations, used in the assessment.

datapoints.label: LEAP-aligned assessment process
datapoints.requirement: Describe the process used to locate, evaluate, assess, and prepare for nature-related issues.

datapoints.label: Nature metrics
datapoints.requirement: Disclose metrics used to assess and manage material nature-related dependencies, impacts, risks, and opportunities.

datapoints.label: Nature targets
datapoints.requirement: Disclose targets and performance used to manage nature-related issues.
